_about: What a datacenter pays: the figures the page shows for the months of the public hourly file (site/public/datacenter/erw_2026_datacenter_hourly.csv and erw_2026_datacenter_carbon.csv, exported 5 November 2026: ERCOT's LZ_NORTH, a flat load bought in real time, the last twelve months 2025-11 to 2026-10), each with its check key (the page's data cell or check key; dc|... is the page's inputs at their defaults) and the tolerance to which the replication must meet it (half of the page's last shown digit). Read by session 1491 from a local build of main (6 November 2026, about 09:00 UTC) in the internal view.

known_differences.window_kg_mwh: session 1491: the page prints 311.68 for a flat load over the window's 10,160 hours, the same figure as the grid's mean beside it (co2:window:grid); the mirror computes 309.84 over the same hours. The one figure the replication does not meet; open in chain 158's faults (session 1491's report).
